Fig. 2. The overview of the proposed PWOOD framework. Orientation Learning and Scale Learning modules enables the Orientation-and-Scale-aware Student
to learn both scale and orientation information from weakly annotated data, as well as Class-Agnostic Pseudo-Label Filtering mechanism enhances pseudo-label
quality by leveraging dynamic thresholds.
